g.text: TECHNICAL LEAD & COMPOSER · PUBLISHED PUZZLE GAME
A puzzle game where you tilt the whole level to defuse a bomb. I architected our custom engine, TTBEngine,
to be modular and flexible enough to keep up with a changing design, and I also wrote the soundtrack, so I
got to shape both how the game works and how it feels.
PLAY IT ON THE DIGIPEN GAME GALLERY ›
